responsibility: This generator emits the target-specific insn construction routines that build RTL from named machine-description patterns, including define_expand, define_split, peephole2 expansion helpers, clobber-augmentation support, and overloaded maybe_code_for_/maybe_gen_ dispatchers. It lowers MD RTL templates into C++ expressions that create or copy rtx nodes, tracks operands, scratches, and hard-register clobbers, and produces the generated insn-emit implementation used by expanders and other RTL-generation code to materialize target instructions.
